duplicate-read.note: 100 matching accepted steer submissions and receipt reads with no native resend

native-acceptance.note: Actual steer receipt admission, claim and accepted native result; owner/job setup excluded

stale-claim.note: One fresh-host receipt read settles a stale durable steering claim as uncertain without replay; claim setup excluded

uncertain-outcome.note: Actual steer receipt admission, claim and uncertainty boundary after an unconfirmed native outcome

uncertain-retry-read.note: 100 uncertain steer retries and receipt reads with no native resend
